task.name: Fix `plan tag` — repo-root CWD and first-version off-by-one

comment.message: De-risk draft ready for review (commit 74de221): GitTags now runs git in repoRoot and nextPlanVersion starts at v1. GitTagsIntegrationTest green from a foreign CWD.

End-to-end verified with the rebuilt fixed image vs old 0.3.12, both launched from a repo SUBDIR (cli/): old CLI -> 'failed to create tag', exit 1; fixed CLI -> 'Created tag: plan-70-v2', exit 0. preflight from subdir now PASS (only local-only WARNs). Mechanism: repoRoot=Paths.get('.'); old GitTags ran git with no .directory() so the subprocess CWD was unreliable under the OpenJ9 launcher; adding .directory(workDir.toFile()) (matching GitState) fixes it. plan-70-v2 created by the fixed image at the closeout commit.
